mqttUsername_help: Leave empty if no auth configured
modbusHint_text: ⚠️ Prerequisite on GX device: Settings → Integrations → Modbus TCP Server → Enabled & Access level → Write access allowed
cleanupOrphanedOutputs_help: On adapter startup, objects for channels no longer reported by the GX are deleted automatically. Recommended after reconfiguration (group changed, channel disabled). Do not enable if devices are frequently offline.
